Meta.title: SCar — Car rental in Morocco
Meta.description: Rent a car in Marrakech, Casablanca, Agadir, Tangier, Fez or Rabat. Clear prices, airport pickup, booking in two minutes.

Common.notFoundBody: This address leads nowhere. Go back to the home page to find your car.

Footer.tagline: Cars ready to go in six Moroccan cities, at a quoted price that doesn't change at the counter.

Home.heroSubtitle: Pick a city and your dates, then collect the keys at a branch or at the airport. The price you see is the price you pay.
Home.fleetSubtitle: From city cars for the medina to 4x4s for the Atlas.
Home.step1Body: Filter by city, dates, gearbox or number of seats.
Home.step2Body: Sign in with Google, Facebook, X, TikTok or Instagram and send your request.
Home.step3Body: A manager confirms within 2 hours. You pay when you collect the keys.
Home.citiesBody: Downtown branches and airport counters. One-way rentals to another city are possible.
Home.trust3: Free cancellation up to 48 h before
Home.ctaBody: Message us on WhatsApp and an advisor will reply in your language.

About.title: A Moroccan agency with well-kept cars
About.body1: SCar was born in Marrakech from a simple idea: customers should know exactly what they pay and what they drive. Every car is serviced between rentals and photographed as it really is.
About.body2: Our managers speak Darija, Arabic, French and English, and the website guides you in nine languages.
About.value1Body: No fees added at the counter. Extras are chosen and priced when you book.
About.value2Body: Full tank, clean interior, tyres checked. If something is missing, we fix it before you leave.
About.value3Body: A WhatsApp number for each branch, reachable day and night during your rental.
